author: Bobby Grayson
title: family/1 now takes the finding, not just its kind, and the impure-helper finding carries family(first.kind). LoomWeb.CostDashboardLive used to read 'distance 1, local helper is not a pure expression' -- which says build local-helper support; it now reads 'distance 1, call to Metrics', which says model Loom.Telemetry.Metrics, four direct :ets.lookup reads of another process's table. Same blocker count, one finding per helper as before; only the label and the family grouping change, and modules whose helpers call several different modules now show their true distance.
